title: Dark Horse Manga Licenses The Sky is but One Roof of the World, H.P. Lovecraft's The Haunter of the Dark Manga
content: Dark Horse Manga announced during its panel at Anime Expo on Friday it has licensed the following manga for release in spring 2027. All the works are available for pre-order now.
author: ANN

title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms 2nd Season Anime Reveals January 2027 Debut
content: The staff for the second season of the television anime of Ran Kuze 's Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms ( Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsūjinai ) manga announced in a teaser video on Friday the season will air in January 2027. Yoshiaki Okumura returns to direct the second season at Synergy SP .
author: ANN

title: 'Steel Ball Run: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken' Unveils Additional Cast, Second Promo
content: The JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure) special panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed additional cast and the second promotional video for the seventh part, Steel Ball Run , on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Officially Confirms Crunchyroll Streaming Date
content: It’s been one year since Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle first made its debut in theaters, and a release date has finally been set for the film’s streaming launch with Crunchyroll.
author: ComicBook

title: Manhwa 'Here U Are' Receives TV Anime
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase panel at Anime Expo 2026 announced that a television anime adaptation of D Jun 's Here U Are manhwa is in production on Friday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), a teaser promotional video, and a commemorative illustration by the author (pictured right).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Movie 1 Begins Streaming on Crunchyroll July 28
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba – Infinity Castle Arc Chapter 1: Akaza Return (Movie 1) will officially begin streaming on Crunchyroll on July 28. This will coincide with the film’s Blu-ray and DVD release , which is scheduled for July 29 in Japan. The film will begin streaming on at 8:00 a.m.
author: Anime Corner

title: Witch Hat Atelier Season 2 Teaser Trailer Revealed
content: Witch Hat Atelier Season 2 anime revealed an ultra teaser trailer during the ongoing Anime Expo 2026 event. The first season of the anime ran for a total of 13 episodes, ending with a cliffhanger during Agott and Richeh’s test. You can watch the new teaser below.
author: Anime Corner

title: J-Novel Club Reveals 7 Light Novel, 2 Manga Licenses, 13 Print Releases
content: J-Novel Club announced licenses for seven light novel series and two manga at its Anime Expo panel on Friday. The first two parts of the first volume for all new light novel series and the first chapter for all new manga are available now.
author: ANN

title: 'Unmei no Makimodoshi' Unveils Main Cast, Additional Staff, Teaser Promo for Spring 2027
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at Anime Expo 2026 revealed the main cast, additional staff, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video for the Unmei no Makimodoshi ( Fate Rewinder ) television anime on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made' Reveals Additional Cast, First Promo
content: The Starry Cube booth at Anime Expo 2026 revealed additional cast and a first promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Haka Tokura and Shin Arakawa 's Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made ( Magical Buffs: The Support Caster Is Stronger Than He Realized! ) manga on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList
